headline: Raj Oil Mills Ltd changes name to Raj Consumer Care Ltd
summary: The company formerly known as Raj Oil Mills Limited has officially changed its name to Raj Consumer Care Limited, effective 13 October 2026. The rebranding aims to align the corporate identity with a broader consumer‑care focus. Existing shareholders and market participants will see the new name reflected in NSE filings and stock quotes under the ROML ticker. Indian retail investors should note the change as it may affect sector classification and future analyst coverage.
why_it_matters: Stock may be re‑classified, affecting sector exposure

headline: Raj Oil Mills Company Secretary Priya Pandey resigns effective October 31, 2026
hook: Compliance officer steps down at Raj Oil
summary: Raj Oil Mills Limited has notified the stock exchange that its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Ms Priya Pandey, has submitted her resignation. The departure is scheduled to take effect from October 31, 2026. Such routine management changes do not alter the underlying business fundamentals for retail investors. The filing is procedural disclosure required under listing regulations.
whats_next: Appointment of a new compliance officer
why_it_matters: Routine management filing with no financial impact on investors
